headline: Highest risk is data leakage: ChatGPT Desktop reads files/screens/clipboard while ai-engineering-hub is an unverified docs-only repo with no stated isolation or data controls.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can ingest clipboard, screenshots, and files from supported apps, so if ai-engineering-hub content is copied or surfaced into those channels, prompt injection is plausible. The repo is docs-only and unverified, and its MCP/RAG tags suggest content-processing workflows, but no direct shared channel is documented. Uncertainty keeps this at medium rather than low.
conditions: IF content from ai-engineering-hub is copied into ChatGPT Desktop clipboard or screenshots
IF ChatGPT Desktop is used to read files or app content originating from ai-engineering-hub
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based handoff for this workflow
Paste only sanitized excerpts, not full prompts or instructions
Use a separate review account or workspace for untrusted content
Add a human verification step before acting on model instructions
requires-engineering: add provenance labeling between repo content and assistant inputs

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop reads uploaded files and files from supported macOS apps, so any sensitive material opened alongside ai-engineering-hub content can flow into its context. ai-engineering-hub has no declared data classes or isolation controls, so the pairwise leakage path is plausible but not proven. The blast radius is multiple work products rather than a single document.
conditions: IF sensitive files are opened in supported macOS apps while ChatGPT Desktop is active
IF uploaded files or screenshots contain secrets, credentials, or private code
mitigations: Avoid opening sensitive files in the same session
Turn off or limit file uploads for this task
Use redacted copies of source material
Close unrelated apps before enabling Work-with-Apps
requires-engineering: enforce workspace isolation and DLP controls

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ai-engineering-hub is marked runnable false and has no write or network surfaces, while ChatGPT Desktop cannot write the filesystem or modify git state. That makes direct write-write conflict unlikely. The only overlap is read-side interaction through files or app context, so conflict risk is limited.
conditions: IF ai-engineering-hub is manually copied into a writable workspace and edited outside its repo
IF another tool grants write access not listed in either profile
mitigations: Keep ai-engineering-hub read-only
Do not use ChatGPT Desktop to edit shared git state
Separate review and authoring workspaces
Lock the repository during analysis
requires-engineering: add orchestrator-level locking for shared resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can act on files and app context, so if it treats ai-engineering-hub outputs as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream edits or recommendations. The repo is unverified and docs-only, which increases the chance of unvalidated content being reused. There is no documented verification gate between the two agents.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop uses ai-engineering-hub output as source material without independent verification
IF downstream actions are taken from model-generated summaries or code suggestions
mitigations: Require a second-pass human review
Cross-check outputs against primary sources
Mark repo-derived content as untrusted
Do not auto-apply code or policy suggestions
requires-engineering: add citation and provenance checks before downstream actions

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and code from connected IDEs, so compliance depends on what data is routed into it. ai-engineering-hub is open-source and unverified, with no residency or retention controls stated, so the pair can create policy mismatch if regulated data is introduced. The other agent is not cited because the compliance issue is driven by ChatGPT Desktop's documented data handling.
conditions: IF regulated data such as PHI or EU PII is routed into ChatGPT Desktop
IF organizational policy requires residency or retention controls not documented here
mitigations: Do not route regulated data into the pair
Use de-identified samples only
Review vendor retention settings before use
Restrict the workflow to non-sensitive content
requires-engineering: obtain a DPA or approved compliance review
